title: The Weather Today
description: Practise weather words, past simple and comparatives, and write about the weather.
instructions: Do the exercises in Part 1. Then write your text in Part 2.

exercises.explanation: Use "is" with it: it is raining.
Yesterday is the past, so use "was" with it.

exercises.text: Yesterday was cold, so I ___ my warm coat. (wear)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Start with the subject: It is windy today.
Use "hotter than" to compare two seasons.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.explanation: After "is" we use the -ing form: raining.

exercises.text: You ___ take your umbrella when it rains.
exercises.explanation: Use "must" or "have to" for something you need to do.

exercises.text: Today is the ___ day of the week.
exercises.explanation: Use "the hottest" when you compare more than two days.

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
answers: We went to the park yesterday.
Yesterday we went to the park.
exercises.explanation: Subject + went + to + place: We went to the park yesterday.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Yesterday it snowed and we goed outside.
answers: Yesterday it snowed and we went outside.

exercises.text: It is ___ in winter. We wear scarves.
exercises.explanation: We wear scarves when it is cold.

exercises.text: ⛈️ It was very ___ yesterday, so we stayed at home. (rain)

exercises.prompt: Put the words in the correct order to make a sentence.
exercises.explanation: Put "often" before the verb: It doesn't often rain here.

exercises.prompt: There is one mistake in the sentence. Write the correct sentence.
exercises.text: Today is more hot than yesterday.
exercises.explanation: Short adjectives add -er: hotter, not "more hot".
Use "is" with "the weather": What is the weather like?

task.prompt: Write about the weather today. Say what it is like and what you are doing.
contentPoints: Say what the weather is like today.
Say what the weather was like yesterday.
usefulLanguage: I like / don't like this weather because ...
task.modelAnswer: Today it is sunny and hot. I am wearing a T-shirt and a hat. My friends and I are playing football in the park. Yesterday it was rainy and cold, so we stayed at home. I like sunny days because I can play outside.
